subject: pugna_decrepify
definition: 降低目标魔抗，或让目标受到更多魔法伤害
evidence: Healing on affected allies is increased, while afflicted enemies take extra magic damage instead.
受作用的友军提升了治疗效果，而受作用的敌军会被减速，并且承受额外魔法伤害。

context.description_en: A powerful banishing spell that slows a unit and renders it unable to attack or be attacked. Healing on affected allies is increased, while afflicted enemies take extra magic damage instead.
context.description_zh: 一个强大的驱逐咒语，能使一个单位进入虚无状态，无法攻击或受到攻击。受作用的友军提升了治疗效果，而受作用的敌军会被减速，并且承受额外魔法伤害。
notes_en: Only magical and pure damage can affect a unit under the effects of Decrepify.
Doesn't slow allied units.
Can be used on your Nether Ward.
notes_zh: 只有魔法伤害和纯粹伤害可以作用于处于衰老状态的单位。
不会对友方单位造成减速。
可以对幽冥守卫施放。

subject: viper_poison_attack
definition: 降低目标魔抗，或让目标受到更多魔法伤害
evidence: 蝮蛇的毒液得到强化，使他的普通攻击附带效果，可以降低目标的移动速度和魔法抗性，并持续造成伤害。

context.description_en: Intensifies Viper's venom, adding an effect to his normal attack that applies a stacking movement speed slow and magic resistance deduction while dealing damage over time. Stacks up to %max_stacks% times.
context.description_zh: 蝮蛇的毒液得到强化，使他的普通攻击附带效果，可以降低目标的移动速度和魔法抗性，并持续造成伤害。效果可以叠加，最多叠加%max_stacks%次。

shard_loc.en: Increases max stacks, and causes Poison Attack to lower armor per stack and to affect buildings for reduced damage.
shard_loc.zh: 提升最大叠加次数，毒性攻击可以降低护甲，并且可以作用于建筑，造成的伤害有所降低。

subject: dragon_knight_wyrms_wrath
definition: 降低目标魔抗，或让目标受到更多魔法伤害
evidence: The life blood of the Dragon improves Dragon Knight's abilities and items to have increased AoE and causes his attacks to deal additional magic damage to enemy units.
神龙的生命之血提升了龙骑士的技能和物品，使其拥有作用范围加成，并且攻击会对敌方单位造成额外魔法伤害。

context.description_en: The life blood of the Dragon improves Dragon Knight's abilities and items to have increased AoE and causes his attacks to deal additional magic damage to enemy units.
context.description_zh: 神龙的生命之血提升了龙骑士的技能和物品，使其拥有作用范围加成，并且攻击会对敌方单位造成额外魔法伤害。

subject: leshrac_greater_lightning_storm
definition: 降低目标魔抗，或让目标受到更多魔法伤害
evidence: Causes Leshrac and all nearby enemies to turn ethereal, preventing them from attacking, slowing them, and making them take more magic damage.
使拉席克和范围内所有敌人变为虚无状态，他们无法攻击，并且承受的魔法伤害增加，移动速度被减缓。

context.description_en: Causes Leshrac and all nearby enemies to turn ethereal, preventing them from attacking, slowing them, and making them take more magic damage. Increases Leshrac's speed rather than reducing it. Does not cause Leshrac to take amplified damage.
context.description_zh: 使拉席克和范围内所有敌人变为虚无状态，他们无法攻击，并且承受的魔法伤害增加，移动速度被减缓。拉席克的移动速度得到提升，而不是减缓。拉席克受到的魔法伤害不会增加。

subject: huskar_blood_magic
definition: 降低目标魔抗，或让目标受到更多魔法伤害
evidence: Huskar's Health Costs are Magical Damage and can be reduced by Magic Resist.

context.description_en: Huskar does not have mana. Mana costs of items are converted into health costs.Huskar's Health Costs are Magical Damage and can be reduced by Magic Resist.
context.description_zh: 哈斯卡没有魔法值。物品的魔法消耗会转换为生命消耗。哈斯卡的生命消耗为魔法伤害，可以被魔法抗性减少。

subject: treant_leech_seed
definition: 降低目标魔抗，或让目标受到更多魔法伤害
evidence: That unit takes additional magic damage, is rooted and disarmed for a short duration, and emits %healing_pulse_count% healing pulses to up to %max_heal_units% nearby allies of Treant Protector based on the damage dealt by the attack.
该单位会受到额外魔法伤害，被缠绕和缴械一小段时间，并放出%healing_pulse_count%次治疗脉冲，最多对附近%max_heal_units%名友军根据当次攻击造成的伤害进行治疗。

context.description_en: Treant's attack plants a life-sapping seed in an enemy unit. That unit takes additional magic damage, is rooted and disarmed for a short duration, and emits %healing_pulse_count% healing pulses to up to %max_heal_units% nearby allies of Treant Protector based on the damage dealt by the attack.
context.description_zh: 树精卫士的攻击会对敌方单位种下一颗吸取生命的种子。该单位会受到额外魔法伤害，被缠绕和缴械一小段时间，并放出%healing_pulse_count%次治疗脉冲，最多对附近%max_heal_units%名友军根据当次攻击造成的伤害进行治疗。

subject: skywrath_mage_ancient_seal
definition: 降低目标魔抗，或让目标受到更多魔法伤害
evidence: 减少魔法抗性的效果对非英雄单位无效。

context.description_en: Skywrath Mage seals the targeted unit with an ancient rune, silencing it and causing it to take additional damage from spells.
context.description_zh: 天怒法师利用上古符文将目标单位封印，目标单位将被沉默，受到魔法伤害时将承受额外伤害。
notes_en: The magic damage resistance reduction doesn't affect creeps.
notes_zh: 减少魔法抗性的效果对非英雄单位无效。

scepter_loc.en: Anytime Skywrath Mage casts Ancient Seal, a different random target within %scepter_radius% range of the original target will be affected by the same ability. Heroes will take priority.
scepter_loc.zh: 天怒法师施放上古封印时，会随机对原目标附近%scepter_radius%范围内另一个敌人施放相同的技能。以英雄为首要目标。

subject: elder_titan_natural_order
definition: 降低目标魔抗，或让目标受到更多魔法伤害
evidence: 护甲降低效果以英雄为中心，魔法抗性降低效果以灵体游魂为中心。

context.description_en: Reduces all elements to their basic levels, removing base armor and magic damage resistance from nearby enemy units. The armor reduction is centered around the hero, while the magic armor reduction is centered around Astral Spirit.
context.description_zh: 使所有元素降低至基础水平，移除附近敌方单位的基础物理护甲和魔法抗性。护甲降低效果以英雄为中心，魔法抗性降低效果以灵体游魂为中心。
notes_en: When the Astral Spirit isn't present, both the armor and magic armor reduction is centered around Elder Titan.
notes_zh: 没有施放灵体游魂时，护甲和魔法抗性降低效果均以上古巨神为中心。

subject: oracle_false_promise
definition: 降低目标魔抗，或让目标受到更多魔法伤害
evidence: DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel Delayed damage and healing will take armor and magic resistance reductions into account when received.

context.description_en:
Temporarily alters an ally's destiny, delaying any healing or damage taken until False Promise ends. Any healing that is delayed by False Promise is amplified. Removes most negative status effects and disables on initial cast.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
context.description_zh:
暂时篡改队友的命运，技能期间受到的任何治疗和伤害效果将在虚妄之诺结束后结算，其中治疗效果结算时效果更强。施放时将移除目标身上大部分的负面状态效果。

驱散类型：强驱散
notes_en: Delayed damage and healing will take armor and magic resistance reductions into account when received.
The delayed damage and healing takes effect as soon as the target becomes vulnerable.
notes_zh: 伤害和治疗效果虽然被延缓结算，但是结算时依然会考虑护甲和魔法抗性的减免。
经过延缓的伤害和治疗效果在目标失去本技能效果后立刻结算。

subject: techies_land_mines
definition: 降低目标魔抗，或让目标受到更多魔法伤害
evidence: Mines detonate if an enemy is standing within the active AoE for %proximity_threshold% seconds dealing damage and temporarily reducing the enemy's Magic Resistance.

context.description_en: Plant an invisible mine that cannot be detected by True Sight, but is visible if an enemy is within the active %radius% AoE of the mine. Mines detonate if an enemy is standing within the active AoE for %proximity_threshold% seconds dealing damage and temporarily reducing the enemy's Magic Resistance. The explosion deals full damage if the target is within %min_distance% radius and decreases down to %outer_damage%%% on the edge. Deals %building_damage_pct%%% damage to buildings.
context.description_zh: 埋布隐形的地雷，不会被真实视域检测到，但是有敌方单位在地雷的%radius%生效范围内会显形。敌人在生效范围内停留超过%proximity_threshold%秒会使地雷爆炸，并且魔法抗性会被暂时降低。爆炸对%min_distance%范围内目标造成全额伤害，对边缘造成的伤害减少至%outer_damage%%%。对建筑物造成%building_damage_pct%%%伤害。
notes_en: Cannot be placed within %placement_radius% AoE of another Proximity Mine.
Proximity Mines do not block neutral creep camps from spawning.
Mines last until they explode or are destroyed.
Mines are triggered by invisible units.
Grants 30 gold if destroyed by an enemy hero.
notes_zh: 感应地雷的%placement_radius%范围内不能再放置地雷。
感应地雷不会阻止中立生物产生。
地雷持续时间没有上限，除非爆炸或被摧毁。
隐形单位也能触发地雷。
敌方英雄将地雷摧毁可以获得30金钱。

subject: dark_willow_shadow_realm
definition: 降低目标魔抗，或让目标受到更多魔法伤害
evidence: Her next attack has %attack_range_bonus% bonus attack range and deals bonus magic damage, and will end Shadow Realm.
她的下次攻击具有%attack_range_bonus%额外攻击距离，并且造成额外魔法伤害，暗影之境技能也会随之结束。

context.description_en: Dark Willow recedes into the shadows, becoming untargetable.  Her next attack has %attack_range_bonus% bonus attack range and deals bonus magic damage, and will end Shadow Realm. Damage scales based on how long she remains under the effects of Shadow Realm, the maximum being reached after %max_damage_duration% seconds.
context.description_zh: 邪影芳灵遁入暗影之境，无法成为攻击或技能的目标。她的下次攻击具有%attack_range_bonus%额外攻击距离，并且造成额外魔法伤害，暗影之境技能也会随之结束。在暗影中时间越长，伤害越高。在暗影之境内的时间超过%max_damage_duration%秒将达到最高伤害。
notes_en: Disjoints projectiles upon cast.
Grants phased movement.
Spells which require vision cannot affect Dark Willow in the Shadow Realm.
notes_zh: 施法时能躲避弹道。
获得相位移动状态。
需要视野的技能无法作用于暗影之境中的邪影芳灵。

scepter_loc.en: Attacking no longer takes Dark Willow out of Shadow Realm. Each attack still has bonus damage based on the duration of the buff.
scepter_loc.zh: 发动普通攻击不再使邪影芳灵脱离暗影之境。持续时间内每次攻击都带有额外伤害。

subject: muerta_spectral_slug

The target is slowed and %bonus_spell_damage_pct%%% more vulnerable to magic damage. Enemies will not be knocked out of Muerta's attack range.
context.description_zh: 琼英碧灵对一个敌人射出一颗幽灵子弹，造成伤害，将其击退并将其变为虚无状态，持续%duration%秒——使他们对物理伤害免疫，并且无法攻击。目标被减速，并且承受的魔法伤害增加%bonus_spell_damage_pct%%%。敌人不会被击出琼英碧灵的攻击距离。

context.description_en: Largo plays a song that deals %burst_damage% magical damage to nearby enemies. The song also increases nearby allied heroes' spell amplification and grants their attacks additional magic damage.
context.description_zh: 朗戈弹奏的乐曲对附近敌人造成%burst_damage%点魔法伤害。乐曲还会使附近友方英雄的技能增强提升，并且他们的攻击造成额外魔法伤害。

scepter_loc.en: Deals additional %damage_per_stack% magic damage per Groovin' stack when this song is used in double-strumming.
scepter_loc.zh: 这首乐曲用于两首共弹时每层律动都会额外造成%damage_per_stack%点魔法伤害。

subject: nevermore_shadowraze1
definition: 让目标受到更多物理伤害或全部伤害（只加深魔法的归上一项）

在目标身上施加一个连中效果，持续时间内再被毁灭阴影击中将受到额外伤害。

Adds a stacking damage amplifier on the target that causes the enemy to take bonus Shadowraze damage per stack.
context.description_zh: 影魔对其正前方区域释放毁灭能量，对该区域中的敌人造成伤害，并且根据当前支配死灵的灵魂数量造成额外伤害。在目标身上施加一个连中效果，持续时间内再被毁灭阴影击中将受到额外伤害。

notes_zh: 连中效果的持续时间在每次连中时刷新。

shard_loc.en: Cooldown reduced by %cooldown_reduction_on_hero_hit%s per enemy hero hit. Applies a stacking %movement_speed_debuff%%% movement speed debuff on enemies hit.
shard_loc.zh: 每击中一名敌方英雄后冷却时间减少%cooldown_reduction_on_hero_hit%秒。对击中的敌人施加可叠加的%movement_speed_debuff%%%移动速度减缓的负面效果。

subject: puck_dream_coil

context.description_en: Creates a coil of volatile magic that latches onto enemy Heroes, damaging and leashing them.  If the enemy hero stretches the coil by moving too far away, it snaps, stunning and dealing additional damage.
context.description_zh: 创造一个变化无常的的魔法梦境来困住敌方英雄，对他们造成伤害和束缚。如果被困住的敌方英雄试图挣脱缠绕走出梦境，将因为梦境破碎而受到眩晕和额外伤害。

scepter_loc.en: All enemies affected by Dream Coil are attacked at a rate equal to %attack_rate_pct%%% of Puck's attack rate. The attacks continue while the target is stunned if they break the Dream Coil.
scepter_loc.zh: 梦境缠绕作用下的所有敌人都会被帕克攻击，攻击频率基于帕克攻击频率的%attack_rate_pct%%%。即使目标挣脱梦境，被眩晕时攻击也会继续。

notes_en: Only magical and pure damage can affect a unit under the effects of Decrepify.
Doesn't slow allied units.
Can be used on your Nether Ward.
notes_zh: 只有魔法伤害和纯粹伤害可以作用于处于衰老状态的单位。
不会对友方单位造成减速。
可以对幽冥守卫施放。

context.description_en: Causes Leshrac and all nearby enemies to turn ethereal, preventing them from attacking, slowing them, and making them take more magic damage. Increases Leshrac's speed rather than reducing it. Does not cause Leshrac to take amplified damage.
context.description_zh: 使拉席克和范围内所有敌人变为虚无状态，他们无法攻击，并且承受的魔法伤害增加，移动速度被减缓。拉席克的移动速度得到提升，而不是减缓。拉席克受到的魔法伤害不会增加。

context.description_zh: 育母蜘蛛用毒液削弱敌方单位，使她的攻击带有减速效果，中毒单位的攻击有一定概率落空，并且被攻击时承受额外伤害。

Additional casts of Sticky Napalm continue to increase damage, up to %max_stacks% stacks. Applies a small amount of damage with each cast.
